text:
Ethan Morales: hi team, excited to join! quick things i hit on day 1: 1) Figma file for product-ui shows "permission denied" 2) couldn't find the latest consolidated roadmap doc. can someone point me to the canonical places? thanks!
Nora Patel: welcome Ethan!! Figma email? i'll add you to the "Redwood Product UI" team and the files.
Ethan Morales: ethan.morales@redwood.ai 44b thanks Nora
design-ops-bot: New hire checklist posted: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product 
- Join: #product-sync, #design-ops
- Figma access: request via Design team
- Roadmap: Product > Roadmap (canonical)
Priya Singh: added you to figma, check invite. roadmap is in Notion -> Product Workspace -> Roadmaps -> Current Quarter. we keep a single canonical page and tag PRDs.
Ethan Morales: got the invite, can open layers now 389. also curious about research: any docs or playbooks on how we run user interviews, recruiting, and sharing notes? want to see recent study transcripts and maybe join next session.
Owen Price: hey Ethan 44b design research lives in Notion under Product > Research Playbook. we use a standard template for discussion guides + consent forms. recruiting is handled via design-ops (they do panel and external recruiting). there is a triage board we update weekly on Wed.
Priya Singh: FYI we publish research summaries to the product slack channel and tag relevant squads. if you want to shadow the next interview ping @Owen and i'll add you to the calendar.
Ethan Morales: perfect. last Q: where are design tokens and who approves token changes? i don't want to accidentally bump spacing/token names in the shared library.
Nora Patel: tokens are in the design system Figma file + the tokens Notion page. small tweaks ok in feature branches but any production token publish needs eng-platform approval. tag @Owen and @platform-team in the PR and run the visual-diff job (we use the Percy workflow).
Owen Price: we also have a short checklist on the tokens page: update changelog, create visual diff, add migration notes. if it's a breaking rename open a ticket in the design-system repo and we'll schedule a 15m review.
Ethan Morales: thanks all! one more onboarding nit: who should I ask for a license/seat for Maze or Lookback?
Priya Singh: Maze seat requests go through design-ops (I'll send the form). Lookback is by request to research-ops. i'll DM you the links.
Ethan Morales: awesome, appreciate it. i'll run through the onboarding checklist and ping if anything else blocks.
Nora Patel: welcome aboard Ethan 680 we'll assign a buddy and add you to design pairing sessions on Tue mornings. see you in the sync tomorrow.
Ethan Morales: thanks team, excited to dive in :)
